gaps.explanation: Statement p6 (proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position, accrual) Total column: User fees 590,841 + Other 35,058 + Interest Income 1,971 = 627,870. Detail comes from the p10 'Schedule of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balance - Budgetary Basis - Proprietary Funds': User fees 593,157 + Line of credit 189,000 + Other 37,029 = 819,186 (printed Total receipts 927,348 less Transfer from other funds 108,162). Schedule above statement by 191,316 = Line of credit 189,000 (printed among budgetary receipts; a loan, not revenue on the accrual statement) + basis difference 2,316 ((593,157 + 37,029) - (590,841 + 35,058 + 1,971) = 630,186 - 627,870). All printed as such; no line to add or remove.

Statement p6 (accrual): Utility operations 455,303 + Depreciation 149,726 + Debt service - interest and fees 14,905 = 619,934. Budgetary schedule p10: Utility operations 1,030,059 + Debt service 192,795 = Total disbursements 1,222,854 (printed). Cash-basis operations include capital purchases (1,030,059 - 455,303 = 574,756), debt service includes principal (192,795 - 14,905 = 177,890), and depreciation 149,726 is not a disbursement: 574,756 + 177,890 - 149,726 = 602,920 = schedule above statement. Different basis, no fix.
